question: The rank of India in Global Hunger Index Report 2021 is:
solution:
The correct answer is "**101**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has dropped from **101st in 2021** to 107th place out of 121 nations in the **Global Hunger Index** (GHI) for 2022, trailing its neighbors Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Nepal.
 
• According to the website of the Global Hunger Index, which records undernourishment,** seventeen nations**, including China, Turkey, and Kuwait, shared the **top spot** with a GHI score of less than five on Saturday.
 
• **India's GHI** rating has likewise **declined**, falling from **38.8** in 2000 to a level of **28.2** and **29.1** between 2014 and 2022.
 
• **India** is classified as "**severe**" with a score of 29.1, a warning that India still** lags behind** in the fight against hunger.
 
• **India** falls behind **Bangladesh** (84), Pakistan (84), Nepal (81), and Sri Lanka (64). (99). The only South Asian nation that ranks lower than India on the index is **Afghanistan** (109).
 
• *Therefore, the correct answer is: 101*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **technique** for fully **measuring** and monitoring **hunger** at the international, regional, and national levels is the **Global Hunger Index** (GHI).
 
• A global hunger index is a tool for **assessing** whether **nations** are meeting SDGs that relate to hunger. It can be applied to **global ranking**.
 
• **Undernourishment**, child stunting, child wasting, and **child mortality** are the four component **indicators** on which the Global Health Index (GHI) scores are based.
 
• The GHI score is determined using a **100-point scale**, with zero representing the best result (no hunger), and 100 representing the worst.
